core_obligations: Record the jump relations of the three parametrices across the contour and the matching of the parametrices with the outer parametrix on the boundary, and note that the author attributes these to the cited section together with the derivation of the parametrices (proof lines 1392-1393).

Reduce the fourth property to the study of the explicit expression of the model parametrix, substituting the two exponential representations of the Szegoe quotients at the endpoint minus one (proof lines 1394-1400).
Apply the definition of the phase function and the tabulated Bessel asymptotics to expand the resulting expression (proof lines 1400-1442).

Use the remaining asymptotic expansions and the elementary logarithmic bound to show that the matrix entries satisfy the two sided growth bound and the bound for the third parametrix, uniformly as the parameter tends to infinity (proof lines 1442-1457).
proof_roadmap: Attribution of the parametrices and of properties (i) and (ii) (proof lines 1392-1393).
Reduction of property (iv) to the model parametrix (proof lines 1394-1400).
Bessel asymptotics and the phase function (proof lines 1400-1442).
Logarithmic bound and the growth estimate (proof lines 1442-1457).
